lines: {target}? Sound travels farther than sense. I would bring the right tool and leave pride behind.
If anyone heads for Deep Dark, tell them: Walk soft and do not open every chest. I will be at the smithing table.
Sculk hears what pride forgets. I will remember that when I tighten the handles.
Deep Dark is no small story. Broken tools are easier to mend than broken people.
I will remember Deep Dark as darkness that listens back. I will tighten the handles before trouble starts.
